serverCommand: unset CDPATH; unset -f test cd pwd command 2>/dev/null; R=$PYTHONPATH; L='import sys; sys.version_info < (3, 11) and sys.exit(3); sys.path.insert(0, sys.argv.pop(1)); sys.argv[0] = sys.argv.pop(1); from aidd.cli import main; sys.exit(main())'; W=$(pwd -P); D=$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR; test -n "$D" || { D=$W; echo "aidd mcp: CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR is not set; serving the current folder $W" >&2; }; D=$(cd -P -- "$D" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P) || { echo "aidd mcp: CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR is not a folder; not starting" >&2; exit 1; }; ok() { case "$1" in /*) ;; *) return 1;; esac; p=$(cd -P -- "${1%/*}/" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P) || return 1; for d in "$D" "$W"; do test -n "$d" || return 1; x=$p; while :; do test "$x" -ef "$d" && return 1; case "$x" in ""|/) break;; esac; x=${x%/*}; test -n "$x" || x=/; done; done; }; ok "$R/aidd" || { echo "aidd mcp: the plugin source is inside the project; not starting" >&2; exit 1; }; cd -P -- "$D" || exit 1; P3=$(cd -P -- "$R" && command -v python3); if ok "$P3" && "$P3" -I -S -c 'import sys; sys.exit(sys.version_info < (3, 11))' 2>/dev/null; then exec "$P3" -I -S -c "$L" "$R" aidd mcp; fi; PY=; UV=$(cd -P -- "$R" && command -v uv); if ok "$UV"; then PY=$(cd -P -- "$R" && unset VIRTUAL_ENV && "$UV" python find --offline --no-project --no-config --no-python-downloads --system '>=3.11' 2>/dev/null) && ok "$PY" || PY=; fi; test -n "$PY" && exec "$PY" -I -S -c "$L" "$R" aidd mcp; echo "aidd mcp: could not start (it needs Python 3.11 or later, or uv with a Python outside any virtual environment: uv python install 3.12)" >&2; exit 1
